作用机理: treating the perovskite surface with different types of ammonium salts reduces the level of electronic defects present at the interface between the perovskite film and the hole transport layer, thereby enhancing the power conversion efficiency.
原文原句: We find that this treatment boosts the power conversion efficiency from 20.5% for the control to 22.3%, 22.1%, and 21.0% for the devices treated with ethylammonium, imidazolium and guanidinium iodide, respectively.
